usage_notice_text: The County Clerk's Office, Sabine County, Texas provides this web site as a public service. Information available on this web site is collected, maintained, and provided solely for the convenience of the public users. While every effort is made to assure that this information is accurate the County Clerk does not certify the authenticity of the information contained herein. The County Clerk shall under no circumstance be responsible for any error or omission which may occur in these records, nor liable for any actions taken as a result of reliance upon any information contained within this web site from whatever source, or any other consequence from such reliance. Images may be unavailable while system backups are in progress.
notes: Seed URL over http returns 403; https works. The Elections page (sabine.Elections) currently lists only May 26, 2026 runoff items: 'MAY 26, 2026 PRIMARY RUNOFF OFFICIAL RESULTS' (Cumulative Results Report, county totals, Official Results, Run Date 06/02/2026; Last-Modified Tue, 02 Jun 2026 19:51:45 GMT), a hand count audit certification and a BBM hand count. The 'Election Results & Required Postings' page stops at 2022 and links 'PRECINCT BY PRECINCT ELECTION RESULTS' to sabine.easydocs.us/election/, which offers only 2017, 2018 and 2022. Nothing for the 2024 general or 2026 primary is posted, and no election-night file for the runoff survives (the official file may have replaced an unofficial one), so no election can be decided from checks 1 and 2. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The usage notice is the disclaimer on the easydocs precinct results page. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not found on origin). Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-J): No change. Wayback harvest returned empty CDX results for all three windows; no targeted archives, targeted wayback or sweep file. One web search found only a 2022 KETK Sabine County results page (published 2022-03-01), not a target election; no election-night precinct publication found.
